_doc: Cross-authority study areas. Every question gets exactly one `topic`. Modelled on the EASA/ICAO theoretical-knowledge subject split because it is the most granular widely-used scheme; FAA, Transport Canada, SACAA and UK CAA subjects all map onto it. The authority's own subject wording stays in `subject` - this is a navigation/study layer only, never a replacement for official terminology.

topics.name: Air Law & ATC Procedures
topics.covers: Licensing, rules of the air, airspace, ATS, aerodromes, signals, SSR codes, registration, airworthiness rules, security, accident reporting, drone regulations

topics.name: Aircraft General Knowledge – Airframe & Systems
topics.covers: Structures, flight controls, landing gear, hydraulics, electrics, fuel/oxygen/cabin systems

topics.name: Aircraft General Knowledge – Powerplant
topics.covers: Piston and turbine engines, ignition, carburation and carb ice, fuel, propellers

topics.name: Instrumentation
topics.covers: Pitot-static, gyro instruments, compass errors, EFIS, airspeed markings

topics.name: Performance
topics.covers: Density altitude, take-off/landing distance, climb, glide ratio

topics.name: Flight Planning & Monitoring
topics.covers: Cross-country planning, fuel planning, NOTAM/briefing sources, flight plans

topics.name: Human Performance & Limitations
topics.covers: Physiology, hypoxia, illusions, vision/scanning, alcohol, fatigue, ADM, hazardous attitudes, CRM, risk management

topics.name: Meteorology
topics.covers: Atmosphere, stability, fronts, icing, thunderstorms, METAR/TAF/winds aloft, forecasts

topics.name: General Navigation
topics.covers: Earth, direction, time, charts, DR, wind triangle, 1-in-60, flight computer, pilotage

topics.name: Operational Procedures
topics.covers: Wake turbulence, windshear, emergency procedures, contaminated runways, towing/launch ops, airmanship procedures

topics.name: Principles of Flight
topics.covers: Lift/drag, stalls and spins, load factor, V-n, stability, ground effect, rotorcraft aerodynamics

topics.name: Communications
topics.covers: Radiotelephony phraseology, radio procedures, communications failure

topics.name: Fundamentals of Instruction
topics.covers: Learning theory, teaching methods, ACS/test standards (instructor licences only)
